'''Kulbart Zamoon''' was a [[Centran]]<ref name="Rogues" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ESB" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who fought in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He joined after the lack of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] intervention against the terrorism on his homeworld of [[Erilnar]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], he attended [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia's]] pilot briefing before heading to his fighter and flying under the callsign [[Blue Twelve/Legends|Blue Twelve]] in the battle. He wore a helmet bearing a blue [[Alliance Starbird]].

==Behind the scenes==
Kulbart Zamoon was first identified in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch]]" in [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]].
